title: bbox_describe_schema edge catalog is hand-maintained and drifts from the kinds EdgeIndex actually projects
wanted_capability: bbox_describe_schema should derive its edge families and per-family kind lists from the same source EdgeIndex projects (or from an observed-kinds pass over the live index), so the catalog agents orient on cannot drift from the graph in either direction. Today edge_families() in crates/bbox-mcp-tools/src/mcp_tools/describe_schema.rs is a hand-written list. Its Knowledge family lists SUPERSEDES, DERIVED_FROM, Contradicts, KNOWLEDGE_FROM_SESSION, KNOWLEDGE_FROM_BOARD, while KnowledgeEdgeKind::edge_kind() (crates/bbox-knowledge/src/knowledge.rs) also emits RelatesTo, TensionWith, Supports, DependsOn, REFERENCES through EdgeIndex::project_knowledge_edges. It also advertises kinds with no producer in the tree (for example KNOWLEDGE_FROM_BOARD, ARC_OPENED_BOARD, COMMIT_PRODUCED_BY_ARC) and omits projected kinds such as COMMIT_EDITED_FILE. Thread structural edges are now advertised and the Roadmap family is retired, so those earlier parts no longer apply.
missing_primitive: single-source edge-family catalog shared by EdgeIndex projection and describe_schema (or an observed-kinds enumeration)
fallback_used: docs/graph-retrieval-internals.md documents the full projected edge table and notes that describe_schema is narrower.
